verdict.rationale: Open Finance is an API-first product with programmatic token generation from Partner ID, secret and appKey. It offers a non-billable, unlimited Test Drive sandbox with test personas and FinBank test institutions. An official GitHub test project generates an API client from the OpenAPI spec, which together support scripted, headless, CI-style automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline docs or examples, evidence that the Connect account-linking step can be completed without a UI, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless runs.
